verdict.detail: FUT.GG's biggest fallers are now Haaland 91 DFG (−3.9%), Olise 91 TOTW (−4.2%) and Icons at −2% to −3%, down from −21% for Gosens earlier. 87s have dropped to 3,100 (0.56 coins per point) and 81–84 sit at the 650 floor.
